GitHub installation token generation: "The installation access token will expire after 1 hour."
gh environment: "GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN (in order of precedence)"
Git credentials: "If credential.helper is configured to the empty string, this resets the helper list to empty"
Git config extraHeader: "an empty value will reset the extra headers to the empty list."
Git config followRedirects: "git will treat all redirects as errors."
GitHub App JWT exp: "The time must be no more than 10 minutes into the future."
GitHub authentication, GitHub's token formats: "stateless format (`ghs_APPID_JWT`)"
Git GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL: "behave as if `protocol.allow` is set to `never`"
